thread:
incident-bot: Pager alert triggered: elevated 5xx rate from infer-runtime cluster us-west-2 (shard: infer-svc-12). Error signature: segmentation fault / OOM in model-runner. Customers affected: multiple production requests -> 502/504.

oncall-maya: seeing spike on dashboard. Linking runbook: https://runbooks.internal/incidents/runtime-5xx. Paging sre-josh.

sre-josh: on it. grabbing current node list and recent deploys. can someone check recent kernel/drivers?

eng-runtime-leo: no deploys in past 2h. Last config change was autoscaler tweak 6h ago. Posting recent logs snippet.

eng-runtime-leo: ```
[2024-10-12T14:02:11Z] model-runner[pid=2345] SIGSEGV at 0x7f8a2e..
#0 0x7f8a2a in attention_forward()
#1 0x7f8a2b1c in kv_cache_lookup()
#2 0x55aa1ef0 in infer_loop()

OOM: cgroup memory high watermark reached on container infer-runner-12
```

support-lina: traffic shows customer A and B saw retries, latency ↑, 30% error rate for embedding endpoints. CS notified customer success Raj.

customer-success-raj: emailed impacted customers with initial ETA: investigating. Collecting logs from their requests for scope.

infra-bot: Node infer-node-47 shows kernel OOM-killer invoked. dmesg excerpt: "Out of memory: Kill process 2345 (model-runner) score 137 or sacrifice child"

prod-ops-aria: hypothesis: model quantization kernel or attention fusion regression -> OOM/segfault under certain sequence lengths. Suggest temporary mitigation: route traffic away from infer-svc-12, enable fallback variant (cpu-safe or smaller-context model), and scale dedicated pool by +2 gpus.

sre-josh: executing reroute now. `reroute --from infer-svc-12 --to infer-svc-legacy --percent 100`

incident-bot: Command accepted: traffic reroute started. Observability: latency to legacy model slightly higher, but error rate dropping.

eng-runtime-leo: pushing hotfix to model-runner image to disable experimental attention fusion. Preparing canary rollout to infer-svc-19.

oncall-maya: rolling canary. please monitor 5xx rate and K8s restarts.

eng-runtime-leo: canary rolled out to 2 pods. logs show no immediate segfaults.

sre-josh: error rate across platform down to ~6% from 32%. Customer impact reduced. Still monitoring for residual OOMs.

support-lina: customer A confirmed reduced failures after reroute. they still see a few transient 502s.

eng-runtime-leo: collecting core dumps for crash analysis. attaching debug build to reproduce locally. If we confirm double-free in attention kernel, will revert fused kernel.

infra-bot: Core dump uploaded: gs://redwood-dumps/1839876543/core-infer-2345.gz

prod-ops-aria: next steps checklist: 1) keep reroute until hotfix validated in prod, 2) roll hotfix globally if canary clean, 3) coordinate postmortem and customer comms, 4) verify autoscaler settings didn't cause tight OOM packing.

oncall-maya: agree. tagging SLO owners and security for KMS logs just in case.

eng-runtime-leo: canary healthy for 12m, no new crashes. requesting global rollout.

sre-josh: starting global rollout now. monitor metrics: `error_rate_5xx`, `kube_restart_rate`, `oom_events`.

incident-bot: Global rollout accepted. Estimated completion 8 minutes.

sre-josh: rollout complete. error rate stabilized ~0.9%. no further OOMs detected on affected shards.

customer-success-raj: notifying customers with remediation summary and ETA for full RCA.

support-lina: updating status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1839876543 - summary: transient model-runner crash/OOM due to attention kernel regression; traffic rerouted and hotfix deployed; mitigation complete.

eng-runtime-leo: next actions: repro locally, write regression test for attention kernel with long sequences, add memory guardrails in runtime, and add alert for KVM cache growth beyond threshold. I'll own the fix and PR.

prod-ops-aria: I'll own the postmortem doc and follow-up action items. tagging @oncall-maya for review.

oncall-maya: thanks all. closing pager once postmortem doc links added. great coordination. :thumbsup:
